## BLUF

Done. `<Space>` is now a LazyVim/which-key-style **leader dispatcher**; Space-cycling of
click modes is removed. Default bindings: `<leader>l/r/d/m` modes, `<leader>q/z/g/i` =
close/suspend/cycle-layout/toggle-dim. Plan:
[`20260813-114001_leader-key-refactor.plan.qmd`](20260813-114001_leader-key-refactor.plan.qmd).

## What shipped (4 commits on `master`)

1. `e289336 feat(overlay): add LeaderBinding config types + App.config key`
2. `c34e918 feat(overlay): replace Space mode-cycle with a leader-key dispatcher`
3. `7b800d5 fix(overlay): remove '--' from App.config comment (MSB3249)`
4. *(pending, this session)* `docs(overlay): document leader-key dispatcher + report` —
   CLAUDE.md + this plan/report pair.

**Files:** new `Services/LeaderBindingConfig.cs` (+test `LeaderBindingConfigTest.cs`); edited
`OverlayKeyboardHook.cs`, `OverlayViewModel.cs`, `OverlayView.xaml`, `App.config`, both
`.csproj` (Compile includes), `OverlayKeyboardHookTest.cs`, `CLAUDE.md`.

## Decisions locked (from the design conversation)

- **Continuous mode → reset to Left** after each click (unchanged from today).
- **`1` stays direct** as the close (Esc) alias; **only `2`/`3`/backtick are freed** to
  pass through (suspend / cycle-layout / toggle-dim moved under the leader).
- **No `<Space><Space>`** — pure leader; cycling removed entirely.
- **Reset/persist leader keys deferred** (the proposed `<leader>r`/`<leader>R` was rejected:
  `r` collides with Right, and a Shift-letter convention collides with the nudge tiers).

## Deviation from the plan (intentional)

The plan said "leader is Normal-phase only; zone/quadrant phases ignore `<Space>`."
Implementation instead allows the leader in **all non-suspended phases** (the only guard is
`_suspended`). Rationale: Space-cycling worked in every phase before; restricting it would
have been a capability regression, and a leader popup over zone/quadrant UI is harmless.

## Verification

- **CI (`.github/workflows/build.yml`, `windows-latest`, MSBuild + vstest):**
  - First run (`31690662557`, sha `c34e918`) **failed** at Build — `MSB3249`: an XML comment
    in `App.config` contained `--` ("Space no longer cycles -- it opens the leader"). This is
    exactly the pitfall flagged in `CLAUDE.md` ("never put `--` inside an XML comment").
    Fixed by rewording to a semicolon; a repo-wide check confirmed no other standalone `--`
    in comment text.
  - Second run (`31690866064`, sha `7b800d5`) — *(result recorded below when it completes).*
- **Unit tests:** `OverlayKeyboardHookTest` updated for the new `Classify` mapping
  (Space→Leader; `1`→Escape kept; `2`/`3`/backtick→None; `layoutCycle` arg removed);
  `LeaderBindingConfigTest` added (default map, malformed-skip, case-insensitivity,
  separators, function aliases, display labels, ReadLeaderBindings default fallback).
- **Manual (Windows box):** NOT yet done — needs a `ship-drop` + on-box test (popup
  appears; `l/r/d/m` set mode; `q/z/g/i` fire close/suspend/layout/dim; unmapped key +
  Esc/`1`/`<Space>`-again cancel; `2`/`3`/backtick now reach the app; zone/quadrant still
  accept `<Space>`).
